'''Preigo''' was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the manager of a traveling [[Circus/Legends|circus]] act known as [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder]].

==Biography==
Preigo was a [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] ringmaster of a nomadic troupe of entertainers, [[Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder/Legends|Preigo's Traveling World of Wonder]], active during the years of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Aboard his colorfully decorated freighter, Preigo carried an exotic menagerie of amusements and diversions to delight the downtrodden.<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Bound for Rescue}}</ref> For a modest fee,<ref name=":1">{{SWE|characters|preigo|Preigo}}</ref> Preigo's traveling performers -- [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] acrobats, [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] tumblers, [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] clowns, and trained creatures<ref name=":0" /> of various stripe, fur, and scale<ref name=":1" /> -- put on performances to entertain the masses.<ref name=":0" /> He would introduce the main event, dramatically riding into the spotlight atop a trained narglatch.<ref name=":1" /> His waxed musatche was the envy of every Dug this side of [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]].<ref name=":2">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref>

In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="FF-2014 10: HMP">{{FactFile2014|10|HMP 1-2|HMP Droid Gunship}}</ref> Preigo traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] after making a special agreement to go again for [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]. The last time he visited him was quite disappointing when one of his artists was decapitated by one of Hondo's [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. Preigo hoped that he would do a great job to impress Hondo since he was afraid to mess up. On the way to Hondo's base, he met five circus acrobats who immediately showed their best side note. However, he had no idea that these acrobats were in fact [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiates]] that were on a mission to rescue [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name=":0" />

During the performance, the Younglings took action by rescuing Ahsoka and were able to cause a distraction. This caused a lot of commotion, in which Preigo did not hesitate and was afraid of what Hondo would do to him. He immediately launched his ship and left the planet.<ref name=":0" />

==Personality and traits==
A fastidious [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] with a huge handlebar<ref name=":1" /> waxed<ref name=":2" /> mustache and outsized personality, Preigo was a perfectionist who felt the show must always go on, especially in times of war and hardship.<ref name=":1" /> He used to wear a small hat.<ref name="SW-Bound for Rescue Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/bound-for-rescue-episode-guide|text="Bound for Rescue" Episode Guide &#124; The Clone Wars}}</ref>
